rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides Google Ads API integration with automatic OAuth 2.0 authentication and token management, built by GoMarble AI using Python and the fastmcp framework. It implements three core tools for listing accessible Google Ads accounts with nested sub-account discovery, executing Google Ads Query Language (GAQL) queries with automatic JSON parsing, and generating keyword ideas through the KeywordPlanIdeaService with search volume and competition metrics. The implementation features seamless OAuth flow handling that automatically triggers authentication when needed, supports both direct account access and manager account hierarchies, and includes comprehensive GAQL reference documentation as a resource, making it valuable for automated Google Ads reporting, keyword research workflows, and building AI assistants that need programmatic access to Google Ads data without manual authentication management.
